en.headline: Autumn travel expo at Wan Chai convention centre ends Sunday
en.dek: The three-day Hong Kong Holiday and Travel Expo in Hall 5BCD runs until 8pm, with a $30 ticket and a 3pm mascot parade.
body: The Hong Kong Holiday and Travel Expo 2026 Autumn holds its last day on Sunday at Hall 5BCD of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.

Exhibition Group Limited is the organiser and the Travel Industry Council of Hong Kong is co-organiser. The fair opened on Friday and is scheduled from 11am to 8pm; ticket sales and public entry stop 30 minutes before closing. Admission is $30, with free entry for people aged 65 or above who show a senior citizen card or identity card, holders of a disability card, and children under one metre tall.

The council said the expo brings together travel agents, destination boards and consulates, and has added a Local Tourism Pavilion. Organisers listed more than 30 seminars and stage shows, a King of Luggage contest, and a mascot parade at 3pm on Saturday and Sunday. Visitors were told to check official notices on site for prize draws and workshop times.

zh.headline: 灣仔會展秋季旅遊博覽會周日閉幕
zh.dek: 香港秋季旅遊博覽會在會展展覽館5BCD舉行至晚上8時，門票30元，下午3時有吉祥物巡遊。
body: 「香港秋季旅遊博覽會2026」周日迎來最後一天，在灣仔香港會議展覽中心展覽館5BCD舉行。
博覽會由展覽集團主辦、香港旅遊業議會協辦，周五開幕，開放時間為上午11時至晚上8時，閉館前30分鐘停止售票及公眾入場。門票30元，65歲或以上出示長者咭或身份證、持傷殘人士證，以及身高一米以下小童免費入場。
旅遊業議會表示，展覽匯聚旅行社、各地觀光機構及駐港領事館，今年增設本地遊專區。大會列出超過30場講座及舞台節目，並設「推喼王」比賽，周六及周日下午3時有吉祥物巡遊。抽獎及工作坊詳情以現場公布為準。
